title: Globe Spin Stories
shareTitle: Globe Spin Stories 🌍 — A Papercraft World Tour
description: Spin a tactile 3D globe, follow its glowing map pin, then open a papercraft storybook to discover an animal, its habitat, and a place wonder across five world regions.
learningGoals: Build a beginning mental map of five world regions
Connect a characteristic animal with its habitat
Practice purposeful swiping, visual search, and multi-step completion
interactionModel: drag or spin a tactile globe, land on one glowing destination pin, and tap three large discoveries inside an illustrated storybook
feedbackModel: Papercraft motion, spoken facts, musical WebAudio cues, passport stamps, persistent progress, and a five-stop celebration make every action legible and rewarding.
credits: Kaigani; GPT Image 2 papercraft illustrations; Natural Earth public-domain land data. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids. See ASSETS.md.
